title: Inganathi South African Road Sign & Road Marking Study Library
note: Educational study reference. Terminology and categories were cross-checked against South African Department of Transport SARTSM material and the RTMC Road Traffic Signs chart. This library is not presented as an official government test specification.

signs.name: Stop
signs.meaning: Come to a complete stop before proceeding when required.

signs.name: Yield
signs.meaning: Give way to traffic that has priority before proceeding.

signs.name: No entry
signs.meaning: Do not enter the roadway from this direction.

signs.name: One-way roadway
signs.meaning: Traffic is permitted to travel in the indicated one-way direction.

signs.name: Keep right
signs.meaning: Keep to the indicated side of the roadway.

signs.name: Proceed left only
signs.meaning: Proceed in the indicated left direction.

signs.name: Proceed right only
signs.meaning: Proceed in the indicated right direction.

signs.name: Proceed straight only
signs.meaning: Continue straight ahead as indicated.

signs.name: Turn left
signs.meaning: Turn left as indicated by the command sign.

signs.name: Turn right
signs.meaning: Turn right as indicated by the command sign.

signs.name: No left turn
signs.meaning: Turning left is prohibited at the sign.

signs.name: No right turn
signs.meaning: Turning right is prohibited at the sign.

signs.name: Speed limit
signs.meaning: Do not exceed the speed shown on the sign.

signs.name: Minimum speed
signs.meaning: Do not drive below the minimum speed shown when the sign applies.

signs.name: No overtaking
signs.meaning: Overtaking is prohibited where the sign applies.

signs.name: No parking
signs.meaning: Parking is prohibited where the sign applies.

signs.name: No stopping
signs.meaning: Stopping is prohibited where the sign applies.

signs.name: Pedestrians only
signs.meaning: The indicated part of the road is reserved for pedestrians.

signs.name: Motorcycles only
signs.meaning: The indicated part of the road is reserved for motorcycles.

signs.name: Motor cars only
signs.meaning: The indicated part of the road is reserved for motor cars.

signs.name: Intersection ahead
signs.meaning: Warns of an intersection or junction ahead.

signs.name: Bend / curve ahead
signs.meaning: Warns that the road alignment changes ahead; reduce speed as appropriate.

signs.name: Railway crossing ahead
signs.meaning: Warns of a railway level crossing ahead.

signs.name: Pedestrians ahead
signs.meaning: Warns that pedestrians may be present or crossing ahead.

signs.name: Children / school area
signs.meaning: Warns of children or a school-related pedestrian hazard ahead.

signs.name: Roadworks
signs.meaning: Warns of roadworks or temporary road conditions ahead.

signs.name: Parking
signs.meaning: Provides information about a designated parking facility or area.

signs.name: Hospital
signs.meaning: Provides information about a hospital or medical facility.

signs.name: Public telephone
signs.meaning: Provides information about a public telephone facility.

signs.name: Temporary roadworks
signs.meaning: Indicates a temporary road condition or roadworks arrangement.

signs.name: Temporary direction / detour
signs.meaning: Shows a temporary route or direction to follow.

signs.name: Stop line
signs.meaning: A transverse road marking associated with a stop control; stop before the line where required.

signs.name: Yield line
signs.meaning: A transverse road marking associated with a yield control; give way as required.

signs.name: Pedestrian crossing
signs.meaning: Marks a pedestrian crossing area and helps identify the crossing location.

signs.name: Lane direction arrow
signs.meaning: Shows the permitted or intended direction of travel from a lane.

signs.name: Barrier / no-crossing line
signs.meaning: A continuous longitudinal marking used to restrict crossing where applicable.
